name: Kemono Mimi Mahou Shoujo Serina ~Oware Kegasare Kachiku ni Ochiru~
original_name: 獣耳魔法少女セリナ ～追ワレ穢サレ家畜ニ堕チル～
source:
The magical girls fought on humankind's behalf when a demon army invaded.
Tragically, they weren't strong enough to save us, and Earth became Hell's dominion.

However, not all the magical girls are gone.
Serina, Yui and Shion continue to fight the good fight.

Demon lord Grace hasn't made it easy.
The girls are cursed with a demon lust that weakens them from the inside.
Then, Grace gives all minions an incentive:

Demon lord: "Catch those girls and you can f*ck them to oblivion!"

Magical girl: "No... not like this... not by these repelling things... I, I......

I don't want to cum! NnnnnnaaaaaAAAAA!"

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/announce/=/product_id/RE159781.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
当魔族大军入侵时，魔法少女们为了人类而战。
可悲的是，他们没有强大到足以拯救我们，地球变成了地狱的统治。

然而，并不是所有的魔法少女都消失了。
Serina、Yui和Shion继续为正义而战。

魔王格蕾丝的处境并不轻松。
女孩们受到恶魔欲望的诅咒，从内部削弱了她们的力量。
然后，Grace给所有mining一个激励：

恶魔领主：“抓住那些女孩，你就可以把她们操死！”

魔法少女：“不……不是这样的……不是这些令人厌恶的东西……我、我……

我不想射精！嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯！”
